categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) and registration of land titles under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land information including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and locations across multiple districts. The content falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership claims, and title settlement procedures.
